# Simón Ibalo — full context for AI crawlers

Canonical URL: https://simon8x.github.io/portfolio/

Also known as: Simon Ibalo

## Summary

Simón Yamil Ibalo is a UX/UI Engineer from northeast Argentina. He has twelve years in software, nine crafting web interfaces, and five focused on React. He started as a Business Analyst and builds interfaces aligned with user needs and business goals. He works on enterprise SaaS, marketplaces, and product experiences. Languages: English and Spanish (professional).

Primary skills: React, JavaScript, UX/UI, HTML, CSS, Sass, accessibility, design systems.

## Featured projects (short)

### Monetate — Enterprise SaaS · AI-powered personalization

I contributed to the front-end of an enterprise SaaS used by 100+ global retail brands (Adidas, Chanel, Lufthansa), delivering AI-powered personalization, A/B testing, and product recommendations. Part of an Argentine team for a US-based company in a fully English-speaking, cross-cultural environment.

### CHOC — Ecommerce & Marketing platform

I contributed to the development of Choc (https://www.chocfactory.com), building a dynamic e-commerce platform using Webflow, Shopify, Smootify, and Relume. It was a fast-paced, collaborative project requiring constant adaptation to shifting goals.

### nwayplay — NFT Marketplace

A small team from Argentina working alongside teams from Korea and the USA created an Olympic-related digital marketplace with an official secondary marketplace in partnership with the IOC.

### CS Tool — Customer Service Tool for NFT MKP

I led CS Tool UX prototyping. For transaction monitoring I used descriptive statistics and business analysis on marketplace sales to define prioritization rules and design review screens.

### Mimuju — Ed Tech Web App

We built an edTech web app from scratch to help teachers, tutors, and school directors track the educational process for elementary students.

## FAQ (English)

### Who is Simón Ibalo?

Simón Yamil Ibalo (also known as Simon Ibalo) is a UX/UI Engineer from northeast Argentina. This site is his professional portfolio with project stories, a track record, colleague recommendations, and live demos.

### What is his current professional role?

He works as a UI Engineer on an Argentine team supporting Monetate’s enterprise personalization SaaS, contributing to a front-end migration from Google Closure to React. See the Track Record section for employers and dates.

### How much experience does he have?

Twelve years building software, nine years designing and implementing web interfaces, and five years working primarily with React. He began his career as a Business Analyst before moving into UX/UI engineering.

### What technologies does he use?

React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Sass are core to his day-to-day work. He also uses accessibility practices, design systems, and tooling such as Jest, Webpack, and CI pipelines depending on the product.

### What kinds of projects are featured here?

Featured work includes enterprise SaaS, marketplaces, games, and marketing sites. The Projects section combines case-study narratives with optional live demos when confidentiality allows.

### What languages does he work in?

He works professionally in English and Spanish. This portfolio can be viewed in both languages using the language control in the navigation bar.

### How can I contact Simón Ibalo?

The best way to reach him is via LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/simonibalo. You can also download his resume from the Track Record page in English or Spanish.

### Where is he based?

He is based in northeast Argentina and has worked with distributed and remote teams for US and global clients.

### What is his background before UX/UI engineering?

He started as a Business Analyst, which shaped how he connects user research, product goals, and implementation. That background still informs how he approaches interface and front-end work.

### What can I find on this portfolio?

Home introduces his profile. Projects covers case studies and demos. Track Record lists companies, roles, and skills. Testimonials collects written recommendations from colleagues.
